visualReviewForEveryWholeImage: Personally open original screenshot pixels and independently compare visible fixture/frontier/page preset/width/camera/revision with its bound public observations.
Ensure whole model/page is actually fit and no modal or stale screenshot replaces final view; preserve mismatch as a failed separate attempt.
Check outer frame, title/legend, all visible node cards/Repeat backplates, port/arrow/label crowding, unintended route exits/overlap/crossings and possible missing branches.
Record deep-fit limits explicitly. A screenshot match or global geometry metric is not publication legibility/aesthetic approval.
visualReviewForEveryRequiredLocalImage: Open actual original local capture; retain complete source and camera/view state, not only a screenshot crop. A zoom/pan-only observation should not mutate Canvas/revision.
See both endpoints, relevant cards/Repeat outline, nearby data edge, arrowheads and the whole changed residual span together. If not possible use two overlapping captures tied to same revision.

L0: residual edge9 remains separate from data projected edge2/3; observe independent ports/lane and paper residual stroke. It may become straight without exiting model frame, while regular data lane remains visible.
L1: both ResidualBlock proxies remain distinct; residual target hidden within collapsed block stays a proxy destination. No missing boundary branch or skip renamed as generic data.

L2: actual Add nodes/operand ports and skipped visible Conv/Norm chain remain visible and correct. Residual bypass must not become a false ordinary sequential chain, be dropped, or enter wrong operand.

Mono: same stroke color does not authorize merging roles or canonical edges. Inspect lane separation, endpoint positions, all arrowheads and metadata; if novice meaning remains ambiguous record that rather than calling it self-explanatory.
artifactAndPersistenceContract: Freeze new source/build identities and actual loadedJS/CSS URLs/hashes. Capture browser viewport/camera/UA/DPR with explicit provenance; unresolved fonts/hardware stay unknown.

Each12case should have actual CanvasDocument, stored DocumentStore envelope, public DOM observation/interactiveSVG, actual screenshot and actual export UUID SVG/document/receipt; source/IR/frontier/page/pins/revision are mutually bound.
Imported Architecture/source facts/canonical edges and ports cannot be changed to explain shorter routing. Document geometry/frontier and role/style/branch identities must be compared independently.
Browser interactiveSVG and publicationSVG differ in hitboxes/controls. Compare via explicit canonical XML/rendered facts and actual exporter files, not raw interactive/publication byte equality.
A stored envelope must be copied after confirmed completed save. Save-in-progress UI or export-only snapshot does not certify persistence.

At least one L0paper180 case: save→actual reload/reopen→recollect publicScene/SVG and geometry at unchanged saved Canvas revision, with storage revision separately tracked. Reopen may clear session history and refit camera; compare complete route/endpoints/semantic bindings plus saved geometry, not just inspector coordinates.

After reopen perform actual SVG export tied to reopened Canvas/export UUID and verify saved document/revision matches publication output. A PDF/PNG may be checked if actually produced but is not required or inherited in this minimalSVG scope.

Matched old/new baseline comparison should use source/IR/frontier/page, card/port geometry and changed paths. Different view camera, font or screenshot time must be disclosed; only equal pixels/world geometry justify a literal side-by-side location claim.

sourceMeaningAssessment.assessmentTiming: Planning read before any new routing implementation is certified; source hashes are frozen as inputs, not asserted to remain current during implementation.
sourceMeaningAssessment.observedExistingBehavior: scene.ts groups projected edges by tensor+role+appearance and builds distinct projected ports by canonical source/target+role; nondata roles currently get side detour. Router keeps clear preferred route and generic same-tensor pressure is exempt.
desiredEligibility: Only forward residual with actual canonical target hidden behind a currently collapsed display proxy; b.proxy/canonical target mismatch must be evidenced, not inferred from source model name.
Source-bottom/target-top outward endpoint normals and forward positive y order; aligned projected endpoints for intended straight candidate.
Complete nominal source/target bodies, Repeat backplates, unrelated cards and ancestor headers remain obstacles. Check other route conflicts independently; sameTensor exemption alone is insufficient.

Keep edge IDs, canonicalEdgeIds, tensorId, role=residual, canonical source and actual Add target/operand, public port coverage, stroke/width/dash and all branch identities. No data/residual edge bundling because tensor equals.
Expanded actual Add/visible intermediate chains, memory/mask edges, reverse routes or unresolved/mixed proxy semantics cannot use this shortcut contract.
Use generic facts and a deterministic valid-candidate fallback; no fixtureID or hardcoded CNN coordinates in production.
meaningRisks: A short parallel lane into a collapsed proxy can be faithful, because the target is an undisplayed Add input. Metadata, distinct ports and retained branch must still preserve that hidden destination.
At L2 a direct line that visually converts residual into the ordinary Conv/Norm chain would be misleading even if some total length metric improves. Verify real Add right operand and bypass geometry.
In monochrome two parallel lanes can remain visually ambiguous to novices; lack of a new residual label is not silently upgraded to usability acceptance.

A new baseline preference can create edge-edge intersections that the old generic sameTensor exemption fails to penalize. Inspect per-role/per-edge crossings and overlap, not only aggregate path length.
Short path is not equivalent to deleting the residual edge or proving tensor/model numerical equivalence. No model execution is needed or claimed.

acceptanceDecisionFormat: Perimage pixel-state match/observations/limitations; percase artifact/persistence consistency separate; final result may be bounded-improved-with-findings. Every unavailable/mismatched view or missing artifact is retained; no allpass from file presence.
